children.name: Equisetum arvense
children.description: Equisetum arvense, commonly known as field horsetail or common horsetail, is a species of vascular plant in the horsetail family Equisetaceae.

children.name: Equisetum bogotense
children.description: Equisetum bogotense, the Andean horsetail, is a herbaceous perennial that reproduces through spores.

children.name: Equisetum braunii
children.description: Equisetum braunii, the northern giant horsetail, is a species of Equisetum (horsetail) native to western North America.

children.name: Equisetum diffusum
children.description: The Himalayan horsetail (Equisetum diffusum) is a perennial that averages at 10–25 inches.

children.name: Equisetum fluviatile
children.description: Equisetum fluviatile, the water horsetail or swamp horsetail, is a vascular plant in the horsetail family Equisetaceae.

children.name: Equisetum giganteum
children.description: Equisetum giganteum is a species of horsetail with the common name southern giant horsetail.

children.name: Equisetum hyemale
children.description: Equisetum hyemale, commonly known as rough horsetail or scouring rush, is an evergreen perennial herbaceous pteridophyte in the horsetail family Equisetaceae native to Eurasia and Greenland.

children.name: Equisetum laevigatum
children.description: Equisetum laevigatum is a species of horsetail in the family Equisetaceae.

children.name: Equisetum myriochaetum
children.description: Equisetum myriochaetum, also known as Mexican giant horsetail, is a species of horsetail that is native to Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador, Peru and Mexico.

children.name: Equisetum palustre
children.description: Equisetum palustre, the marsh horsetail, is a perennial herbaceous pteridophyte belonging to the subclass of horsetails (Equisetidae).

children.name: Equisetum praealtum
children.description: Equisetum praealtum, the scouringrush horsetail, is a species of Equisetum (horsetail) native to North America and northeastern Asia.

children.name: Equisetum pratense
children.description: Equisetum pratense, commonly known as meadow horsetail, shade horsetail or shady horsetail, is a widespread horsetail (Equisetophyta) and it is a pteridophyte.

children.name: Equisetum ramosissimum
children.description: Equisetum ramosissimum , known as branched horsetail, is a species of evergreen horsetail (genus Equisetum, subgenus Hippochaete).

children.name: Equisetum scirpoides
children.description: Equisetum scirpoides (dwarf scouring rush or dwarf horsetail) Michx., Fl.

children.name: Equisetum sylvaticum
children.description: Equisetum sylvaticum, the wood horsetail, is a horsetail (family Equisetaceae) native to the Northern Hemisphere, occurring in North America and Eurasia.

children.name: Equisetum telmateia
children.description: Equisetum telmateia, the great horsetail, is a species of Equisetum (horsetail) native to Europe, western Asia and northwest Africa.

children.name: Equisetum variegatum
children.description: Equisetum variegatum, commonly known as variegated horsetail or variegated scouring rush, is a species of vascular plant in the horsetail family Equisetaceae.

children.name: Equisetum xylochaetum
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Peru to N. Chile. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
